## Flagship Products & Toolkits

- [n8n Production Hardening Pack](https://deepakbagada.in/products/n8n-hardening-pack): Deterministic 12-rule offline static auditor and resilience CLI that eliminates silent workflow drops and injects exponential retries.
- [Agent Skills Master Bundle](https://deepakbagada.in/products/agent-skills-master-bundle): Complete production collection of reusable agent skills, MCP servers, and context kernels for Claude Code, Cursor, and Antigravity.
- [Agency Delivery OS](https://deepakbagada.in/products/agency-delivery-os): Turnkey client delivery framework with scope-of-work generators, audit templates, and client onboarding workflows.
- [Agent Context Architect](https://deepakbagada.in/products/agent-context-architect): Deterministic context engineering pack for optimizing prompt token bleed, RAG window pruning, and context compaction.
- [AI Lead Intelligence Engine](https://deepakbagada.in/products/ai-lead-intelligence-engine): Autonomous pipeline for scraping, verifying, and enriching high-intent B2B leads with email validation.
